subject: Assurance packet for procurement — control mapping & KMS/retention proofs
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@stalwarttech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stalwarttech.com
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement: assurance packet & control mapping request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Stalwart Tech's procurement review we need a consolidated assurance packet that covers SOC 2, ISO 27001 alignment and our SIG questionnaire items. To scope our procurement checklist, can you confirm the following and share artifacts where possible: 

- A control crosswalk mapping Redwood controls to SIG/SOC2/ISO clauses (spreadsheet preferred).
- KMS/key management proof showing key custody model and evidence of rotation (can be snippet/redacted).
- Log retention policy and sample logs or retention confirmation for application and platform logs.
- Any existing third-party attestation PDFs (SOC 2 Type II, ISO cert) and dates.

Our deadline for the procurement packet is 2029-04-18. Can you provide an initial packet or a lead contact and timeline by Friday (2029-04-05)?

Thanks,
Alice Wu
Sr. Procurement Manager
Stalwart Tech

--
Attachment: none (please attach preferred)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@stalwarttech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement: assurance packet & control mapping request

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear list. We can get most of this into a consolidated packet ahead of your deadline. High-level plan and ask: 

1) What we'll deliver by 2029-04-12 (initial packet):
   - Control crosswalk (SIG -> SOC 2 / ISO controls) — spreadsheet.
   - KMS model summary + redacted rotation log snippet.
   - Log retention policy text and example retention matrix.
   - Links to latest SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 certificate (where available).

2) Owners and timeline:
   - Security will provide KMS proof and logs (Aditya, cc'd).
   - Compliance will assemble crosswalk and certificates (Kimberly, cc'd).
   - I'll own the packet assembly and delivery to you.

3) Next steps: please confirm if any of these need to be signed (DocuSign) or uploaded to a secure intake (SFTP/Drive) and any additional procurement form fields we should populate.

Attaching an initial crosswalk outline to accelerate review — expect more artifacts after Aditya/Kimberly confirm.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Assurance Lead | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Alice Wu <alice.wu@stalwarttech.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2029 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement: assurance packet & control mapping request

Adding detail on the artifact owners and expected formats so we can avoid churning with procurement: 

- Control crosswalk: spreadsheet with columns (SIG question, SIG control id, Redwood control id, SOC2 mapping, ISO mapping, evidence file name). I'll complete the SOC2/ISO mapping columns and flag controls that need supporting evidence.
- KMS key proof: we can supply a one-page architecture diagram + redacted KMS rotation audit (pdf). Security can redact key identifiers; we'll include rotation timestamps and roles.
- Logs & retention: provide the policy text + retention matrix (system x retention period). For sample logs, provide redacted examples and a statement of how long we preserve platform and application telemetry.
- Attestations: we will include the most recent SOC 2 Type II cover page and ISO certificate. If Stalwart needs full report access, we can coordinate an NDA + secure link.

I'll own creation of the crosswalk spreadsheet and will drop a v1 in the shared Drive folder. Aditya — can you confirm availability to produce the KMS snippet and a sample rotation entry by EOD Mon (2029-04-08)?

Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@stalwarttech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Apr 2029 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement: assurance packet & control mapping request

Thanks Rachel/Kimberly — that works. A couple of clarifying asks from our security team before you assemble: 

- For the KMS proof: can you explicitly state the key custody model (Redwood-held vs customer-managed) and whether keys used for customer data are stored in a customer-controlled KMS (if applicable)? A single sentence is fine.
- For retention: procurement wants to see the exact retention period for authentication logs vs application request logs. If you can provide a short file with the matrix that calls out retention (e.g., auth logs = 90 days, request logs = 365 days), that would speed review.
- Finally, do you have a secure intake link or DocuSign manifest we can use for formal packet sign-off?

If you can send an initial packet or links by Tue 2029-04-09 that will keep us on track.

Best,
Alice
Vendor Security (Procurement) | Stalwart Tech

Hi Alice / team —

Quick update and artifacts attached/linked below. Per Kimberly's ask, here's what I'm sharing now: 

- KMS custody model: Redwood holds tenant master keys by default in a customer-segregated KMS namespace. For customers with strict key control requirements we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) and provide encryption proofs on request.

- Attached artifacts (redacted where necessary):
   * kms_key_proof_snippet.pdf — one-page snippet showing architecture and a redacted rotation log entry (dates + roles only).
   * log-retention-policy-snippet.txt — retention matrix (auth logs = 90 days; request/application logs = 365 days; infra telemetry = 180 days).
   * redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx — updated with SOC2/ISO columns and evidence pointers.
   * docsign_assurance_manifest.url — secure DocuSign manifest for formal packet acceptance (if you require signature).

Drive link to a secure intake folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEF_example
HubSpot record: 22419

If you need additional detail (e.g., raw rotation auditing entries under NDA) tell us the minimum scope and we will arrange secure transfer. Otherwise I can package the rest of the packet for delivery on 2029-04-12 as planned.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
